title: [elegance] smtp_relay.rs reinvents RFC 5322 header parsing instead of using mailparse
description: The smtp_relay.rs module manually parses email headers (find_header_end, parse_email_addrs) instead of using mailparse (0.15), which is already a dependency in the reader crate. Current approach breaks on: quoted strings with commas ('To: "Alice, Bob" <alice@example.com>'), comments after addresses, RFC 2047 encoded-words, and address folding. The reader crate already uses mailparse::parse_headers elsewhere (validate_headers.rs, lifecycle.rs). Migrate to mailparse for consistency and RFC correctness.
